craft_notes: Sthāyin: vikalpa-sattarka-śakti unit 23 — vīrya-vimarśa of contested doctrine (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). Sanskrit-first: technical terms held (sattarka, dvaitādhivāsa, śaktipāta, codanā, akiṃcitkara); the twelve-fold kalana steps kept in order (u38). Rows: 1 (question-answer gait: nanu/maivam), 9 (verdicts line-final: na kiṃcit, akiṃcitkara), 2 (catalogues kept whole: śakti-names, kalana-ops), 6 (imperative close: ācaret). Close: cited-authority lines land flat. Rejected: softening the akiṃcitkara claim — killed: siddham is the text's word; attributing the kecit-view as fact — killed: u44's argument is contested, keep its hedged heat. lines: All states are made of the Lord's light:
consciousness-fire light, desiring to swallow all
states — sudden dissolution of all states into

c1_essence: Homa: all states Lord-light; swallowing-taste in Lord-consciousness-fire; sudden dissolution to mere light-residue.
